symptom: `create association X …` errors "association already exists" on re-run and aborts the script
cause: Correct SQL-shaped semantics (like `CREATE TABLE`) — `create` is not idempotent. The idempotent form is `create or modify association`, but it was undiscoverable from the bare error
insight: Not a code bug in the write path — improve the error to name `create or modify association …` and `drop association …`. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/51-create-or-modify-association.mdl`. FINDINGS #51
